channel.description: HuYongshuang's blog website focuses on sharing technologies related to Minecraft's redstone, commands, servers, etc., as well as more technical content in areas such as mathematics, networks, and computers. Infinite creation, infinite possibilities.

item.title: Binary Arithmetic
item.description: Minecraft binary arithmetic operations including logic gate circuits, half adders, full adders, adders, addition-subtraction modules, multipliers, dividers, etc.
item.author: HuYongshuang

item.title: Rubik's Cube formula
item.description: This article includes the basic solving methods of 3x3 Rubik's Cubes, as well as the 2x2, 4x4 and 5x5 Rubik's Cubes.
item.author: HuYongshuang

item.title: 5×5 Rubik's Cube formula
item.description: This article mainly introduces the basic solving method for the 5×5 Rubik's Cube, which consists of two main steps: solving center pieces and solving edge pieces. After completing these steps, you can continue solving the cube following the procedures for a 3×3 Rubik's Cube.
item.author: HuYongshuang

item.title: 4×4 Rubik's Cube formula
item.description: This article mainly introduces the basic solving method for the 4×4 Rubik's Cube, which consists of two main steps: solving center pieces and solving edge pieces. After completing these steps, you can continue solving the cube following the procedures for a 3×3 Rubik's Cube. Two special cases may occur during the solving process that need to be addressed.
item.author: HuYongshuang

item.title: 2×2 Rubik's Cube formula
item.description: This article mainly covers the basic solving method for the 2×2 Rubik's Cube, which includes two main stages: solving the bottom layer and solving the top layer.
item.author: HuYongshuang

item.title: All States, Transformations and Solving Steps for the Top Face of a 3×3 Rubik’s Cube
item.description: This article mainly focuses on all possible states that may appear during the top-face solving stage of a 3×3 Rubik's Cube, along with their transformations and corresponding solving procedures.
item.author: HuYongshuang

item.title: 3×3 Rubik's Cube formula
item.description: This article mainly introduces the basic solving method for the 3×3 Rubik's Cube, consisting of three major stages: solving the bottom layer, solving the middle layer and solving the top layer.
item.author: HuYongshuang

item.title: Hexo Tutorial (5) - Deploy to Cloud Server
item.description: Preparation for deploying Hexo to a cloud server: 1. Local Hexo project files that have been completed; 2. Purchased cloud server, such as Tencent Cloud, Alibaba Cloud, etc.; 3. Server system: CentOS or Ubuntu; 4. Server has opened ports: 22 (SSH), 80 (HTTP), 443 (HTTPS, optional); 5. Obtained server public IP, root account password/key; 6. Purchased domain name and registered (unregistered cannot be accessed) (optional); 7. Purchased SSL certificate (can be accessed via HTTPS) (optional).
item.author: HuYongshuang

item.title: Hexo Tutorial (4) - Comment System
item.description: There are many plugins for the comment system, and many themes also have built-in comment system plugins. Let's take the Redefine theme as an example to introduce the usage of the Waline comment system.
item.author: HuYongshuang

item.title: Hexo Tutorial (3) - Themes
item.description: The main content of this section is about the installation and usage of Hexo themes. Taking the Redefine theme as an example, the content is roughly divided into two parts: installing the Redefine theme and configuring the theme.
item.author: HuYongshuang

item.title: Hexo Tutorial (2) - Configuration
item.description: If you have installed a Hexo theme, most of the settings will be handled in the _config.[theme].yml file of the theme configuration. Since the priority of the theme configuration file is higher than that of the Hexo configuration file, most of the information about the Hexo configuration file will not be necessary to pay attention to. I will introduce a few commonly used settings of Hexo configuration files at the end.
item.author: HuYongshuang

item.title: Hexo Tutorial (1) – Site Construction, Deployment & Writing
item.description: This article mainly walks you through building a personal blog website from scratch using Hexo and GitHub Pages, covering five sections: preparation, creating a GitHub repository, installing Hexo, deploying to GitHub Pages, and basic blog writing.
item.author: HuYongshuang
